title: Java Programming
description: A gentle 15-week introduction to Java using Think Java 2e Chapters 1-13, OpenJDK 26, IntelliJ IDEA, and a staged personal project.

defaultGradingPolicy.description: Each published assignment requirement contributes equally; separately submitted work is reviewed by the instructor.

assignments.title: Week 1 - Hello, World!
assignments.description: Create, run, and submit the same small Hello World program introduced in Think Java Chapter 1.

assignments.title: Week 2 - My Profile
assignments.description: Store a few facts in variables, perform one calculation, and print the results.

assignments.title: Week 3 - Temperature Converter
assignments.description: Ask the user for a Celsius temperature and display the Fahrenheit equivalent.

assignments.title: Week 4 - Message Methods
assignments.description: Complete three small methods and call them from main in the requested order.

assignments.title: Week 5 - Age Group
assignments.description: Use one if/else-if/else chain to classify an age as child, teen, or adult.

assignments.title: Week 6 - Vowel Counter
assignments.description: Loop through one word and count its vowels.

assignments.title: Week 7 - Score Summary
assignments.description: Traverse a provided array and print its total, average, and highest score.

assignments.title: Week 7 - Personal Project Proposal
assignments.description: Plan a small Java program that you can finish in stages during the course.

assignments.title: Week 8 - Recursive Countdown
assignments.description: Complete a carefully scaffolded recursive countdown with one base case and one recursive call.

assignments.title: Week 9 - String Explorer
assignments.description: Create transformed String values and demonstrate that the original String does not change.

assignments.title: Week 10 - Personal Project Part 1
assignments.description: Build the simple, functional Java prototype described in your approved proposal. No other assignment is due this week.

assignments.title: Week 11 - Validated Message Builder
assignments.description: Practice mutable strings and a validation loop that can be reused in Personal Project Part 2.

assignments.title: Week 12 - Safe Book Class
assignments.description: Design a small class that validates constructor data and demonstrates Java exception handling.

assignments.title: Week 13 - Searchable Student Roster
assignments.description: Build an immutable Student class, store Student objects in an array, traverse the roster, and search it sequentially.

assignments.title: Week 14 - Validated Playlist
assignments.description: Build an object that owns a list and uses a regular expression to reject invalid titles.

assignments.title: Week 15 - Personal Project Part 2
assignments.description: Expand Part 1 into a polished Java project using the advanced skills practiced in Weeks 11-14.
